author: Peter K. Gerlach, MSW
note: Gerlach's roster of ~112 subselves (some shared across categories). App catalog target: 100 parts. Shared descriptions marked; missing app-part flags where roster diverges.

parts.functionSummary: Provides motivation and drive to 'get things done now'; fuels productivity and accomplishment in Self-led systems.
parts.protectiveIntention: Prevents stagnation, apathy, and purposelessness by maintaining forward momentum.
parts.distinguishingBehaviors: In false-self systems becomes overactive (Type A, driven) or suppressed (apathy, boredom, self-indulgence). Distrusts or ignores true Self leadership.

parts.functionSummary: Specializes in analyzing—making sense and meaning of sensory information through logic, evaluation, and synthesis.
parts.protectiveIntention: Protects fragile Inner Kids from painful feelings by intellectualizing; may overactivate to avoid emotional awareness.
parts.distinguishingBehaviors: Conclusions ignored or distorted by Guardians (Magician, Catastrophizer, Cynic, Idealist, Critic, Pleaser) when false self rules. Overactive Analyzer = 'always in head.' Numb-er may join to block feelings.

parts.functionSummary: Expresses creativity, imagination, and artistic talent; generates novel ideas free from adult logic constraints.
parts.protectiveIntention: Provides outlet for self-expression and innovation; counters shame-based discounting of creative gifts.
parts.distinguishingBehaviors: Shame-based people discount innate talents ('I can't write'). Also appears as Creative Child / Artist / Inventor in Inner Children (shared description).

parts.functionSummary: Envisions long-range possibilities and future trajectories; provides strategic foresight.
parts.protectiveIntention: Guards against short-sighted decisions; prepares system for future challenges.
parts.distinguishingBehaviors: No individual description page found; listed only on roster. Flag for verification.

parts.functionSummary: Promotes healthy diet, balanced work/play/exercise/rest, and appropriate preventive/curative care; coordinates wholistic wellbeing.
parts.protectiveIntention: Prevents self-neglect and health deterioration; counters hypochondria driven by Catastrophizer/Worrier/Pessimist/Scared Child.
parts.distinguishingBehaviors: Paralyzed or ignored in false-self systems (chronic self-neglect). Teams with True Self, Practical Adult, Nurturer, Spiritual One for recovery. Partners with Nurturer/Humanist for others' health.

parts.functionSummary: Specializes in retrieving historical information like an internal librarian; stores and retrieves memories for other subselves.
parts.protectiveIntention: Preserves learning from past experiences; protects Inner Kids from painful memories via distortion (Magician), numbing (Anesthetist/Analyzer), or repression (Blocker).
parts.distinguishingBehaviors: Observer passes data to Historian. Critic, Perfectionist, Guilty/Shamed Kids, Analyzer, Moralizer, Adult process data for decisions. Magician distorts to protect; Anesthetist/Analyzer numb emotions; Blocker prevents risky memories.

parts.functionSummary: Motivates concern for welfare of others and living things; extends nurturance beyond self.
parts.protectiveIntention: Counters isolation and self-absorption; fosters connection and contribution.
parts.distinguishingBehaviors: No individual description page found; listed only on roster. Flag for verification.

parts.functionSummary: Drives acquisition of knowledge and skills; maintains curiosity and growth orientation.
parts.protectiveIntention: Prevents stagnation and rigidity; supports adaptation through learning.
parts.distinguishingBehaviors: No individual description page found; listed only on roster. Flag for verification.

parts.functionSummary: Enforces internalized moral standards and rules; evaluates behavior against ethical frameworks.
parts.protectiveIntention: Protects from guilt, shame, and social rejection by maintaining 'correct' behavior.
parts.distinguishingBehaviors: Processes Historian's data for decisions. Can become rigid and punitive when false self rules.

parts.functionSummary: Instinctively motivated to love and nourish self and others; promotes health, growth, and wellbeing in living things.
parts.protectiveIntention: Counters self-neglect and self-abuse from Shamed/Guilty Children and their Guardians; prevents Reactive Attachment Disorder.
parts.distinguishingBehaviors: In healthy systems cares for self and others equally. In wounded systems: undeveloped/overwhelmed → cannot form genuine bonds, failed relationships, unavailable parenting, social isolation. Recovery requires introducing Nurturer to Inner Kids who don't know/trust it.

parts.functionSummary: Notes inner/outer events calmly, factually, objectively without bias; akin to scientist or media reporter. Meditation quiets other subselves to access Observer.
parts.protectiveIntention: Provides accurate data for wise decisions; prevents flooding (too much info) or deprivation (too little). Guards young subselves from perceived dangers (scorn, rejection, criticism, intrusion, loss, abandonment).
parts.distinguishingBehaviors: Passes observations to Historian for storage. Analyzer, Perfectionist, Pleaser, Critic use reports. True Self uses Observer + other Managers for decisions. Balanced awareness = observing 'enough.'

parts.functionSummary: Regulates tempo of activity and rest; maintains sustainable rhythm across subselves.
parts.protectiveIntention: Prevents burnout from overdrive and stagnation from underdrive.
parts.distinguishingBehaviors: No individual description page found; listed only on roster. Flag for verification.

parts.functionSummary: Seeks meaning, purpose, and understanding of life's fundamental questions; integrates experience into coherent worldview.
parts.protectiveIntention: Counters existential anxiety and nihilism; provides framework for values-based decisions.
parts.distinguishingBehaviors: No individual description page found; listed only on roster. Flag for verification.

parts.functionSummary: Prioritizes and arranges physical/abstract things in useful order; devises and executes effective plans for short/long-term goals.
parts.protectiveIntention: Prevents chaos and missed opportunities; distinct from rigid Guardian compulsivity about neatness.
parts.distinguishingBehaviors: Works with Adult + Analyzer + Achiever + True Self. Overcome by Lost Child, Scared Child, Catastrophizer, Worrier, Cynic when false self disables Managers. 'Disorganized' often means false-self control.

parts.functionSummary: Applies pragmatic, grounded common sense to daily decisions; balances idealism with feasibility.
parts.protectiveIntention: Prevents impulsive or unrealistic choices; grounds system in reality.
parts.distinguishingBehaviors: Partners with Organizer, Analyzer, Achiever, True Self for effective planning. No individual description page found; listed only on roster. Flag for verification.

parts.functionSummary: Ranks tasks, values, and goals by importance; allocates energy and attention accordingly.
parts.protectiveIntention: Prevents overwhelm and misallocation of resources; ensures vital needs met first.
parts.distinguishingBehaviors: No individual description page found; listed only on roster. Flag for verification.

parts.functionSummary: Synthesizes and transmits knowledge; mentors other subselves and external others.
parts.protectiveIntention: Counters ignorance and confusion; empowers through understanding.
parts.distinguishingBehaviors: No individual description page found; listed only on roster. Flag for verification.

parts.functionSummary: Facilitates connection, communication, and rapport with others; values interpersonal harmony.
parts.protectiveIntention: Prevents isolation and social alienation; builds support networks.
parts.distinguishingBehaviors: No individual description page found; listed only on roster. Flag for verification.

parts.functionSummary: Connects to Higher Power or spiritual dimension; provides transcendent perspective and guidance.
parts.protectiveIntention: Counters hopelessness and meaninglessness; offers source of wisdom beyond ego.
parts.distinguishingBehaviors: Teams with True Self, Nurturer, Health Director for recovery. No individual description page found; listed only on roster. Flag for verification.

parts.functionSummary: Embodies resilience and endurance; ensures continuity through adversity.
parts.protectiveIntention: Guarantees survival at all costs; maintains life force under threat.
parts.distinguishingBehaviors: No individual description page found; listed only on roster. Flag for verification.

parts.functionSummary: Natural talent for effective inner-family leadership; guides all subselves with wisdom, compassion, and clarity.
parts.protectiveIntention: Harmonizes entire system; prevents any single subself from dominating destructively.
parts.distinguishingBehaviors: Capital 'S' Self vs. small 's' self (all subselves + soul/spirit + body). Can be blocked/disabled by distrustful subselves (blending). Lesson 1 aim: free Self to guide. When Self leads, Analyzer's conclusions valued, Organizer plans effectively, Critic moderates, etc.

parts.functionSummary: Embodies accumulated wisdom, discernment, and long-view perspective; mentors from experience.
parts.protectiveIntention: Prevents repetition of past errors; provides calibrated judgment.
parts.distinguishingBehaviors: No individual description page found; listed only on roster. Flag for verification.

parts.functionSummary: Carries primal terror of being left alone; feels unworthy of connection.
parts.protectiveIntention: Signals desperate need for attachment; drives clinging or preemptive withdrawal.
parts.distinguishingBehaviors: Core wound: 'I will be left.' Guardian protectors activate to prevent re-experiencing abandonment.

parts.functionSummary: Anticipates danger and catastrophe; hypervigilant to threat cues.
parts.protectiveIntention: Warns system of perceived dangers; mobilizes Guardians for protection.
parts.distinguishingBehaviors: Triggers Catastrophizer, Worrier, Pessimist, Numb-er. Overactive Analyzer tries to protect this Child from painful feelings. 'Alex is always in his head.'

parts.functionSummary: Experiences wonder, reverence, and openness to mystery; unguarded appreciation of beauty.
parts.protectiveIntention: Preserves capacity for joy and transcendence; counters cynicism.
parts.distinguishingBehaviors: No individual description page found; listed only on roster. Flag for verification.

parts.functionSummary: Feels listless, unstimulated, and empty; craves novelty and engagement.
parts.protectiveIntention: Signals need for growth, play, or meaning; prevents stagnation.
parts.distinguishingBehaviors: No individual description page found; listed only on roster. Flag for verification.

parts.functionSummary: Generates novel ideas and expressions free from adult logic; instinctive creativity and imagination.
parts.protectiveIntention: Provides safe outlet for feelings; counters rigidity and control.
parts.distinguishingBehaviors: Shared description with Manager Artist/Creative One/Inventor (same URL). Free from adult constraints ('logic'). May be Curious Inner Child ally.

parts.functionSummary: Driven to investigate, discover, and understand; approaches world with open inquiry.
parts.protectiveIntention: Expands system's repertoire; counters fear-based avoidance.
parts.distinguishingBehaviors: No individual description page found; listed only on roster. Flag for verification.

parts.functionSummary: Resists control, demands autonomy; asserts 'no' against perceived oppression.
parts.protectiveIntention: Protects sovereignty and dignity; prevents enmeshment and coercion.
parts.distinguishingBehaviors: Also appears as Rebel / Defiant One / Rule Breaker in Guardians (shared URL). Guardian version more extreme/rigid.

parts.functionSummary: Experiences unrestrained joy, enthusiasm, and anticipation; fully present in positive moments.
parts.protectiveIntention: Sustains vitality and hope; counters depression and numbness.
parts.distinguishingBehaviors: No individual description page found; listed only on roster. Flag for verification.

parts.functionSummary: Seeks attention and validation through performance, humor, and charisma; 'Look at me!'
parts.protectiveIntention: Counters invisibility and worthlessness; secures love through delighting others.
parts.distinguishingBehaviors: Also appears as Entertainer / Clown / Joker in Guardians (shared URL). Guardian version more defensive/manipulative. Marked * = may be Guardian subself.

parts.functionSummary: Escapes into imagination, daydreams, and mystical realms; creates alternative realities.
parts.protectiveIntention: Buffers unbearable reality; preserves hope and possibility.
parts.distinguishingBehaviors: Also appears as Fantasizer / Dreamer in Guardians (shared URL). Guardian version more dissociative/denial-based. Marked * = may be Guardian subself.

parts.functionSummary: Generates primal pre-verbal feelings; holds earliest somatic imprints (terror, need, rage, bliss).
parts.protectiveIntention: Signals foundational unmet needs; demands primal care.
parts.distinguishingBehaviors: Pre-verbal, somatic. Source of raw feeling states that older parts manage.

parts.functionSummary: Naturally sociable, content, and open; enjoys connection without agenda.
parts.protectiveIntention: Models healthy attachment; reinforces safety in relationships.
parts.distinguishingBehaviors: No individual description page found; listed only on roster. Flag for verification.

parts.functionSummary: Intolerant of delay, obstacles, and unmet wants; demands immediate gratification.
parts.protectiveIntention: Signals urgent unmet needs; pushes for action.
parts.distinguishingBehaviors: No individual description page found; listed only on roster. Flag for verification.

parts.functionSummary: Earns love through compliance, perfection, and self-sacrifice; suppresses own needs.
parts.protectiveIntention: Prevents rejection and punishment by being 'good enough.'
parts.distinguishingBehaviors: Allies with Perfectionist, Pleaser Guardians. Suppresses authenticity for safety.

parts.functionSummary: Carries pervasive sense of wrongness; believes 'I am bad' for existing, feeling, or wanting.
parts.protectiveIntention: Pre-empts external blame by self-condemning first; maintains attachment via self-blame.
parts.distinguishingBehaviors: Processes Historian's data for self-punishment. Hinders Nurturer's self-care. Allies with Shamed Child and Critic.

parts.functionSummary: Feels powerless, incapable, and at mercy of circumstances; expects rescue.
parts.protectiveIntention: Avoids responsibility and failure by claiming incompetence; elicits care from others.
parts.distinguishingBehaviors: Also appears as Victim / Martyr / Loser in Guardians (shared URL). Guardian version more entrenched/identity-based.

parts.functionSummary: Holds grievances, betrayals, and emotional wounds; 'You hurt me and I won't forget.'
parts.protectiveIntention: Guards against re-injury by maintaining defensive wall; demands acknowledgment.
parts.distinguishingBehaviors: No individual description page found; listed only on roster. Flag for verification.

parts.functionSummary: Excessive energy, impulsivity, and difficulty settling; 'NEW' per Gerlach roster.
parts.protectiveIntention: Discharges overwhelming arousal; distracts from painful feelings via motion.
parts.distinguishingBehaviors: Marked NEW on roster. May overlap with Impatient / Hyper One Guardian.

parts.functionSummary: Approaches world with openness and trust; lacks defensive cynicism.
parts.protectiveIntention: Preserves capacity for genuine connection; counters paranoia.
parts.distinguishingBehaviors: Vulnerable to exploitation; Guardians (Skeptic, Cynic) protect this Child.

parts.functionSummary: Uses humor, mischief, and absurdity to deflect tension and gain attention.
parts.protectiveIntention: Diffuses conflict through laughter; hides vulnerability behind antics.
parts.distinguishingBehaviors: Shared URL with Entertainer/Performer/Star (kid-09) and Guardian Entertainer/Clown/Joker (grd-15). Marked * = may be Guardian subself.

parts.functionSummary: Feels unseen, unknown, and without belonging; 'No one knows I'm here.'
parts.protectiveIntention: Avoids further invisibility by hiding; paradoxically ensures not being seen.
parts.distinguishingBehaviors: Overcomes Organizer/Planner's talent. Allies with Scared Child, Catastrophizer, Worrier, Cynic to disable Managers.

parts.functionSummary: Offers unconditional affection and devotion; seeks reciprocal bond.
parts.protectiveIntention: Secures attachment through giving love; models healthy relating.
parts.distinguishingBehaviors: No individual description page found; listed only on roster. Flag for verification.

parts.functionSummary: Aches for connection and attention; feels empty without others' presence.
parts.protectiveIntention: Signals deprivation; drives proximity-seeking behaviors.
parts.distinguishingBehaviors: No individual description page found; listed only on roster. Flag for verification.

parts.functionSummary: Freezes under excessive demand or stimulation; 'I can't handle this.' Marked NEW.
parts.protectiveIntention: Shuts down to prevent total system collapse; conserves energy.
parts.distinguishingBehaviors: Marked NEW on roster. Triggers Guardian Anesthetist/Numb-er, Blocker.

parts.functionSummary: Expresses raw fury and destructive impulses; 'I'll destroy what hurts me.'
parts.protectiveIntention: Deters threat through intimidation; releases trapped survival energy.
parts.distinguishingBehaviors: Also appears as Rager in Guardians (shared URL, noted 'may be an inner child'). Guardian version more calculated/weaponized.

parts.functionSummary: Prematurely takes on adult roles, cares for others, suppresses own childhood needs.
parts.protectiveIntention: Maintains family functioning; prevents collapse by over-functioning.
parts.distinguishingBehaviors: Parentification. Allies with Perfectionist, Taskmaster Guardians. Denies own Inner Child needs.

parts.functionSummary: Demands own way without regard for others; 'I deserve it all.' Marked NEW.
parts.protectiveIntention: Compensates for early deprivation; claims what was denied.
parts.distinguishingBehaviors: Marked NEW on roster. May overlap with Entitled One / Jealous One Guardian.

parts.functionSummary: Feels fundamentally flawed, exposed, and unworthy; 'There is something wrong with me.'
parts.protectiveIntention: Hides true self to avoid annihilating judgment; shrinks to survive.
parts.distinguishingBehaviors: Processes Historian's data for self-condemnation. Hinders Nurturer's self-care. Allies with Guilty Child and Critic.

parts.functionSummary: Uses deception, manipulation, and secrecy to navigate unsafe environments.
parts.protectiveIntention: Survives by concealing truth; controls information flow.
parts.distinguishingBehaviors: Shared URL with Con artist/Thief/Cheat, Liar/Spy/Secret Keeper Guardians. Child version more survival-based, less malicious.

parts.functionSummary: Expresses sexuality, sensuality, and romantic longing; often manifests as teen energy.
parts.protectiveIntention: Seeks intimacy and validation through physical connection; asserts aliveness.
parts.distinguishingBehaviors: Often a teen part. May overlap with Flirt/Seducer/Slut/Voyeur Guardian.

parts.functionSummary: Engages others with ease, joy, and spontaneity; plays for play's sake.
parts.protectiveIntention: Builds social bonds; counters isolation through lightness.
parts.distinguishingBehaviors: No individual description page found; listed only on roster. Flag for verification.

parts.functionSummary: Gerlach notes '(others)' — additional Inner Children not individually cataloged.
parts.protectiveIntention: Acknowledges roster is not exhaustive; each person has unique parts.
parts.distinguishingBehaviors: Flag: app may have parts not in Gerlach's list, or vice versa.

parts.functionSummary: Inflicts harm on self or others to discharge rage and exert control; most extreme Guardian.
parts.protectiveIntention: Pre-empts victimization by becoming perpetrator; maintains power through terror.
parts.distinguishingBehaviors: Extreme end of Guardian spectrum. 'Fiercely dedicated to protecting us and our naive, needy Inner Kids' via violence.

parts.functionSummary: Uses substances, behaviors, or processes to numb, escape, or self-soothe; compulsive repetition.
parts.protectiveIntention: Anesthetizes unbearable feelings (shame, terror, grief); provides predictable relief.
parts.distinguishingBehaviors: Partners with Anesthetist/Numb-er, Blocker. 'Protective' logic: better addiction than feeling.

parts.functionSummary: Numbs emotions, blocks awareness, and prevents remembering painful things; chemical/psychic anesthesia.
parts.protectiveIntention: Shields Inner Kids from overwhelming pain; allows functioning despite trauma.
parts.distinguishingBehaviors: Allows remembering but numbs emotions (with Analyzer). Blocker prevents risky memories (repression). Partners with Addict, Overwhelmed Child, Scared Child.

parts.functionSummary: Evades situations, people, and internal experiences perceived as threatening; flight response.
parts.protectiveIntention: Prevents exposure to triggers; maintains safety through absence.
parts.distinguishingBehaviors: Procrastination, social withdrawal, emotional unavailability. 'Forgetting,' 'spacing out.'

parts.functionSummary: Lashes out with cruelty, sarcasm, and verbal aggression; preemptive attack to deter closeness.
parts.protectiveIntention: Repels potential rejecters/abusers; 'I'll hurt you before you hurt me.'
parts.distinguishingBehaviors: Rage attacks, screaming. Protects vulnerable Inner Kids via intimidation.

parts.functionSummary: Imagines worst-case scenarios; 'We're gonna die!' Amplifies threat perception.
parts.protectiveIntention: Prepares for maximum danger; mobilizes full defensive resources.
parts.distinguishingBehaviors: Triggers Health Director hyper-concern (hypochondria). Allies with Worrier, Pessimist, Scared Child. Distorts Analyzer's conclusions.

parts.functionSummary: Frames life as zero-sum contest; must win to be safe; views others as rivals.
parts.protectiveIntention: Prevents domination and loss of status; ensures survival through superiority.
parts.distinguishingBehaviors: No individual description page found; listed only on roster. Flag for verification.

parts.functionSummary: Orchestrates people and situations to guarantee safety; uses covert influence and exploitation.
parts.protectiveIntention: Eliminates uncertainty by micromanaging reality; prevents helplessness.
parts.distinguishingBehaviors: No individual description page found; listed only on roster. Flag for verification.

parts.functionSummary: Ceaselessly catalogs flaws, failures, and mistakes; discounts praise; rebukes every perceived sin.
parts.protectiveIntention: Pre-empts external criticism by attacking first; maintains impossible standards to avoid shame.
parts.distinguishingBehaviors: Works with Cynic/Doubter, Perfectionist, Worrier, Catastrophizer. Takes over Self, lives in traumatic past. Protects Inner Kids from harm. Hal & Sidra Stone's 'Embracing Your Inner Critic' referenced.

parts.functionSummary: Deceives, steals, and cheats to secure resources and advantage; manipulative exploitation.
parts.protectiveIntention: Ensures survival in perceived scarcity; 'take before taken from.'
parts.distinguishingBehaviors: Shared URL with Liar/Spy/Secret Keeper and Sly/Dishonest Child. Guardian version more calculated/predatory.

parts.functionSummary: Expects the worst, discounts the positive; 'Nothing works, no one cares.'
parts.protectiveIntention: Prevents disappointment by lowering expectations; 'protects' from hope.
parts.distinguishingBehaviors: Distorts Analyzer's conclusions. Allies with Catastrophizer, Worrier, Scared Child, Lost Child to disable Managers.

parts.functionSummary: Seeks danger and intensity to feel alive; counters numbness through adrenaline.
parts.protectiveIntention: Breaks through deadness; proves invulnerability through survival.
parts.distinguishingBehaviors: No individual description page found; listed only on roster. Flag for verification.

parts.functionSummary: Scatters attention, prevents sustained focus on painful or threatening material.

parts.distinguishingBehaviors: No individual description page found; listed only on roster. Flag for verification.

parts.functionSummary: Inflates self-importance to mask deep inadequacy; demands admiration and special treatment.

parts.distinguishingBehaviors: No individual description page found; listed only on roster. Flag for verification.

parts.functionSummary: Uses humor and performance to deflect, charm, and control; 'Laugh so you don't see me hurt.'

parts.functionSummary: Demands special rights, resents others' advantages; 'I deserve more.'

parts.functionSummary: Imposes rigid ideology with absolute certainty; destroys dissent to maintain control.

parts.distinguishingBehaviors: No individual description page found; listed only on roster. Flag for verification.

parts.functionSummary: Escapes into elaborate fantasy worlds; denies reality through dissociation and magical thinking.
parts.protectiveIntention: Creates safe internal reality when external world is unbearable.
parts.distinguishingBehaviors: Shared URL with Fantasizer/Dreamer/Mystic Child (kid-10). Guardian version more dissociative/denial-based. Marked * = may be Guardian subself.

parts.functionSummary: Uses sexuality to gain power, validation, or safety; performs desirability.

parts.distinguishingBehaviors: May overlap with Sensual/Sexual Child. No individual description page found; listed only on roster. Flag for verification.

parts.functionSummary: Performs extraordinary feats to prove worth and gain love; savior complex.

parts.functionSummary: Accumulates and refuses to discard; 'I might need it someday.'

parts.distinguishingBehaviors: May overlap with Entitled One/Jealous One. No individual description page found; listed only on roster. Flag for verification.

parts.functionSummary: Condemns self and others by rigid moral categories; prejudice as protection. Marked NEW.

parts.distinguishingBehaviors: Marked NEW on roster. No individual description page found; listed only on roster. Flag for verification.

parts.functionSummary: Performs false self for approval; wears masks, hides authentic reactions.

parts.functionSummary: Embodies terrifying, chaotic, 'crazy' energies; scares self and others into compliance.
